value.rationale: Exact VC and online depths of a canonical three-alternative rational-choice predicate reveal a five-step adaptive gain and, by independent-context additivity, an unbounded exact learning-complexity gap. The natural choice-model motivation supports these particular invariants; the numerical lower bound is backed by a complete decision-tree certificate rather than a mere sampling result.
